lanes.summary: The diff correctly implements 2 of the 4 sub-problems named in PMAT-4621's title: it adds F16/IQ4_XS CUDA dequant kernels (verified variants exist in WeightQuantType and are wired into qwen35_dequant_f32) and chunks the dense prefill (generate_2.rs) to keep the attention-score buffer within a fixed byte budget, with a matching fix (graph_may_run) so the opt-in CUDA-graph replay path can't be taken by a non-initial chunk. Traced the last_row/hidden_buf2 indexing and the chunk-loop's KV-append semantics (contract_pre_prefill_incremental!) and found them internally consistent. qk-norm forced-serial and chat-KV-2048 (the other two named sub-problems) are untouched here, but git log/commit messages ("#4620 carries roots 1+5 only") and the ticket's own 50%/InProgress status show this is a disclosed, intentional split rather than an omission.

findings.claim: dense_prefill_chunk_rows multiplies by raw num_heads rather than the GQA-aware heads_per_kv used by the pre-existing attention_rows_for/chunk_rows_for helper in forward_qwen35_cuda_prefill.rs, making the new helper a semantic near-duplicate that is more conservative (smaller chunks) under GQA but not incorrect.
